تحتبسوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَبِسُوا (taḥtabisū) /taħ.ta.bi.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# تُحْتَبَسُوا (tuḥtabasū) /tuħ.ta.ba.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
